# Finca S'Espinal — Menorca

> Exclusive rural finca for sale in Menorca, Spain. 30,000 m² agricultural estate in Sant Climent, near Mahón. Traditional 19th-century stone villa with 4 bedrooms, private pool, 15 outbuildings, private well, and greenhouse. Located inside the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Contact for price.

## Property Details

- Total surface: 30,000 m²
- Main villa: 240 m², 4 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, fireplace, traditional kitchen
- Year built: 1891 (original stone construction, habitable)
- Location: Sant Climent, Mahón, Menorca, Balearic Islands, Spain
- Land classification: Agricultural rural (suelo rústico agrícola)
- UNESCO Biosphere Reserve: Yes (since 1993)
- Legal status: Segregation process underway
- Reference: FSE-2026-MEN

## What the property includes

- Traditional Menorcan villa built in 1891
- Private swimming pool with century-old olive tree garden
- 15 auxiliary structures: 3 garages, warehouses, workshop, shed, greenhouse, stables
- Private well with full irrigation system (water self-sufficiency)
- Fertile limestone soil, high agricultural quality
- Panoramic terraces and outdoor wood-fired oven
- Direct road access in good condition
- Full electrical connection

## Location & distances

- 5 minutes from Menorca Airport (direct European connections)
- 8 minutes from Mahón city centre (capital of the island)
- 10 minutes from southern beaches (Cala en Porter, Son Bou, Binibèquer)
- 35 minutes from Ciutadella (historic western capital)

## Investment highlights

- Protected island: Menorca law severely limits rural land development
- Scarcity asset: No new comparable properties can be created
- Multiple uses: private residence, luxury agritourism, organic farming, private retreat
- Growing luxury market: sustained demand from high-net-worth European buyers
- Authentic alternative to Ibiza and Mallorca
